jobs.title: Senior Finance Lead, Credit Card
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TILT TEAM

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.



THE OPPORTUNITY: SENIOR FINANCE LEAD, CREDIT CARD


Tilt's Strategic Finance (StratFin) team is hiring a Senior Finance Lead dedicated to the Credit Card business unit. You'll be the embedded finance lead for Credit Card, owning the P&L, driving forecasting and unit economics, and acting as the primary financial thought partner to Credit Card product, credit/risk, and marketing leadership. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to BU and executive leadership, and regular input into board-level reporting. Given the seniority of the role, you'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy and to shape strategic direction for the business, not just execute against it.



HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Own the Credit Card P&L: Drive the monthly forecast-vs-actual process, variance analysis, and financial reporting for the Credit Card business, including inputs to company-wide board and executive materials.

 - Be the embedded finance partner: Serve as the primary point of contact between Finance and Credit Card leadership — attending BU staff meetings, flagging financial risk/opportunity in real time, and translating operating decisions into financial impact.

 - Own unit economics: Build and maintain the Credit Card unit economics model (CAC, LTV, contribution margin, portfolio yield, delinquency and loss curves) and use it to evaluate new product, pricing, and credit line initiatives.

 - Drive planning cycles: Lead the Credit Card-specific inputs to annual planning and quarterly re-forecasts, ensuring assumptions are grounded and resourcing tradeoffs are made explicit.

 - Build the business case: Partner with Credit, Product, and Marketing to size and evaluate new initiatives — pricing changes, acquisition channel shifts, portfolio strategy — with rigorous, data-backed analysis.

 - Partner with Credit/Data Science on portfolio performance: Translate model and portfolio performance (delinquency, roll rates, approval/pricing strategy) into financial terms for leadership.

 - Shape strategic priorities: Independently identify risks and opportunities in the Credit Card business and proactively bring recommendations to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked.

 - Drive AI-enabled finance workflows: Identify and implement opportunities to use AI tools (e.g., Claude, internal automation via Aleph/Databricks) to accelerate reporting, variance analysis, and ad hoc modeling — reducing manual cycle time and freeing capacity for higher-value strategic work. Set an example for the broader StratFin team on responsible, effective AI-assisted analysis.

 - Improve the reporting infrastructure: Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting so Credit Card metrics are visible, self-serve, and decision-ready for stakeholders.



WHY YOU’RE A GREAT FIT

 - 6+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, bizops, management consulting, or investment banking; lending, credit card, or consumer finance experience strongly preferred

 - Demonstrated track record of owning a P&L or business unit's financial narrative at a senior level, including direct engagement with BU and executive leadership

 - Strong unit economics and financial modeling skills, ideally with exposure to credit/lending economics (loss rates, yield, CAC/LTV)

 - Comfortable with SQL; experience with Databricks and/or Aleph a plus

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to drive real efficiency gains in financial analysis or reporting — not just casual use, but a demonstrated habit of building and scaling

 - Proven ability to build trust and influence with non-finance BU leaders (product, credit/risk, marketing), including pushing back on flawed assumptions and supplying alternatives

 - A get-it-done mindset — resourceful, hands-on, comfortable in the weeds despite seniority

 - Strong strategic thinking and ability to structure ambiguous problems independently, with minimal oversight

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior/executive and board-level audiences

 - Advanced degree (MBA or related) preferred; experience working across international markets or with global/multi-currency businesses is a plus
   



Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.





WHAT YOU'LL GET AT TILT

 - Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

 - Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

 - Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

 - Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

 - Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

 - Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


THE TILT WAY

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.



You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.title: Risk Operations Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TILT TEAM

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.






THE OPPORTUNITY: RISK OPERATIONS TRANSFORMATION LEAD

Tilt is hiring a Risk Operations Transformation Lead to help Risk Operations scale through better processes, tooling, analytics, partner delivery and automation. This is a hands-on, execution-oriented role where you will lead changes from problem definition through implementation and measurement, including: redesigning operational processes, improving internal tooling, transitioning appropriate work to external partners or automation, establishing operating metrics, and ensuring teams are ready when policies, products or systems change.

This is not a traditional project coordination or PMO role. You'll own a portfolio of programs and be accountable for measurable improvements, working closely with Risk Operations, Fraud Strategy, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Data, Shared Services and Vendor Management.

Tilt is a remote-first company that fosters connectivity through regular offsites. Travel for company offsites is required at least twice per year.




HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Serve as the Risk Operations business owner for AI Enabled Operations, prioritizing automation opportunities by volume, complexity, customer impact and operational risk

 - Define the requirements, decision logic, controls and success measures for Risk automation, and partner with Product and Engineering through design, testing and launch

 - Monitor automation after launch (adoption, accuracy, quality, risk outcomes and savings) and lead improvements when results fall short

 - Lead transformation programs that simplify Risk Operations processes, workflows, roles and handoffs, from problem definition through adoption and measurement

 - Identify work that can move to better tooling, self-service capabilities or BPO partners, and define tooling improvements with Product and Engineering

 - Work with Shared Services and Vendor Management on operational readiness, including documentation, training, quality controls, escalation paths and post-launch monitoring

 - Define the metrics that show performance, capacity, quality and risk trends, and use them to find root causes and prioritize improvements

 - Keep new processes, tools and automation aligned with requirements set by Compliance, Fraud Strategy and other policy owners

 - In your first 90 to 180 days: build a prioritized program portfolio, deliver initial improvements, and show measurable movement in an outcome such as SLA attainment, backlog age, quality, loss outcomes or cost per case



WHY YOU’RE A GREAT FIT

 - 5+ years of experience in Risk Operations, Fraud Operations, Disputes, Credit Risk, Trust and Safety, Compliance Operations, operations strategy, program management or a related field

 - Track record leading operational improvement or transformation programs, including redesigning processes, implementing tools or launching automation, from problem definition through measurement

 - Strong understanding of how operational queues, investigations, reviews and escalations work in practice

 - Strong analytical skills, with experience using operational data to identify trends, diagnose root causes and make recommendations

 - Able to turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, requirements and measurable results while managing multiple complex initiatives

 - Able to influence stakeholders and drive decisions without direct authority

 - Clear written and verbal communication with frontline teams, technical partners and senior leadership

 - Sound judgment on operational risk, controls, prioritization and escalation

 - Experience in fintech, payments, banking or another highly regulated environment

 - Preferred but not required: BPO or distributed-team transitions; change-management experience; writing product or business requirements; SQL and Looker, Tableau or Databricks; familiarity with capacity models, SLA and quality measures, and regulations such as Reg E, Reg Z and UDAAP

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager, Upper Funnel
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TILT TEAM

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


THE OPPORTUNITY: SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER, UPPER FUNNEL

As Tilt's Senior Growth Marketer focused on Upper Funnel acquisition, you will establish and lead the brand response marketing function - a strategic priority as the company prepares to make significant investment in upper-funnel channels. You will own the media strategy and execution across connected TV (CTV), YouTube, and additional top-funnel platforms, while developing robust measurement frameworks that clearly link brand investments to tangible business outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to define a new capability within a rapidly growing fintech company and influence how millions of people engage with Tilt.




HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Own upper-funnel go-to-market media strategy. Design, launch, and iteratively optimize campaigns across CTV, YouTube, and other top-funnel channels, ensuring a strong balance between compelling brand storytelling and measurable contributions to core business growth (acquisition, revenue, and lifetime value).

 - Advance measurement rigor. Create methodologies that demonstrate causal connections between brand spend and revenue incrementality where direct attribution is limited. Incorporate advanced approaches to measure touchpoint influence, including multi-touch attribution models, brand lift studies, geo-holdout tests, and incrementality experiments, to clearly link upper-funnel touchpoints to downstream revenue lift and long-term value.

 - Help design and measure optimized brand marketing funnel touch-points—mapping key awareness and consideration moments to create a structured, sequenced journey that efficiently moves audiences toward engagement and conversion while maximizing overall funnel efficiency.

 - Optimize budget allocation. Provide data-informed guidance on deploying and refining a significant upper-funnel budget to maximize alignment with both brand equity and performance objectives. Use funnel diagnostics and touchpoint performance data to dynamically reallocate spend toward the highest-ROI moments in the customer journey.

 - Collaborate on brand narrative development. Partner closely with brand and creative teams to ensure campaigns authentically reflect Tilt's mission and resonate deeply with the audience we serve—hardworking people seeking financial progress. Align narrative elements across touchpoints to maintain consistency and build cumulative brand momentum from awareness through consideration.

 - Communicate insights effectively to leadership. Translate upper-funnel campaign results into core business terms—revenue lift, incrementality, and scalable growth—so executives can make informed, confident investment decisions. Present clear views on how optimized touchpoints contribute to overall funnel health, efficiency gains, and predictable scaling.

 - Build a scalable capability. Establish enduring processes, playbooks, and standards to support efficient upper-funnel operations as investment and scale increase over time. Develop frameworks for ongoing touchpoint auditing, funnel mapping, and performance benchmarking to ensure the brand marketing system remains adaptable and high-performing.
   


WHY YOU'RE A GREAT FIT

 - 6+ years in growth marketing, with a meaningful portion leading upper-funnel marketing (CTV, Youtube, etc)

 - Background from an upper-funnel ad platform (Google/YouTube, Meta, Amazon Ads, Roku, Microsoft), a performance-oriented agency, or a company running substantial brand marketing investment.

 - Hands-on experience managing TV and/or CTV campaigns — from planning and buying through optimization and reporting.

 - Proven ability to measure ROAS and incrementality in channels where direct attribution is limited; you know how to make the business case for brand investment with imperfect data.

 - Deep familiarity with upper-funnel platform capabilities — particularly YouTube and CTV — and how to leverage their measurement tools to tell a clean, credible performance story.

 - Strategic thinker and doer: you've led upper-funnel strategy and can define a point of view, influence stakeholders, and execute against it.

 - Experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Amplitude; SQL is a plus.
